article.title: Minnesota takes on Toronto in non-conference action
article.linkText: Minnesota takes on Toronto in non-conference action
article.story: Toronto Raptors (1-0, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0, sixth in the Western Conference) Minneapolis; Sunday, 7 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Minnesota takes on Toronto in a non-conference matchup. Minnesota finished 49-33 overall a season ago while going 26-15 at home. The Timberwolves averaged 26.1 assists per game on 42.6 made field goals last season. Toronto went 46-36 overall last season while going 22-19 on the road. The Raptors averaged 29.5 assists per game on 42.6 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles). Raptors: Nate Bittle: day to day (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
